transport: Authenticated MCP email-router-queue, record-email-proposal, list-email-proposals, confirm-email-filing and inherit-email-thread

matching.outcome: existing, new or uncertain. Proposal kind is a transport hint, never automatic filing authority.
matching.candidates: Array of deal UUID, literal explanation in reason and confidence between zero and one. Model suggestions require human review.
matching.evidence: Diagnostic object with model revision, existing and different scores, choice_confidence, missing metadata and body_truncated. Diagnostic text is untrusted data.
matching.new: A genuinely separate transaction requires positive different evidence and low existing evidence with structured sender, recipients and conversation metadata. Another property within an existing search is not a new transaction.
matching.uncertain: Contradictory scores or incomplete metadata produce reviewable existing-deal suggestions. Sender identity alone never authorizes filing.

read.match_evidence: Nullable stored diagnostic result. Legacy rows return null.
read.suggested_deals: Current accessible open deals with deal UUID, name, reasons and requires_confirmation=true. Computed for every pending matching card regardless of age. Closed and invoiced deals are excluded. Name similarities remain identity candidates and never write links.
read.digest: email-filing.v1 preview shape and digest inputs are preserved. Suggestions and diagnostics do not authorize confirmation.

association.provenance: Human confirm-email-filing stores source activity, party, exact selected deal and confirming actor on the confirmed proposal.
association.scope: message when conversation_id is absent; otherwise thread with that exact conversation_id. No sender-wide authority is inferred.
association.reuse: Queue exposes learned_associations from confirmed source messages still filed to the learned deal. Router checks these before generic model matching. inherit-email-thread revalidates the source, transaction, chronology, recipient set, conflicting filed threads, open deal and Undo suppression on the server.
association.undo: Automatic filings use the existing inherit-email-thread event, list-email-thread-filings receipt and undo-email-thread-filing command. Undo prevents refiling.

repair.bound: Exactly one pending matching proposal per command, addressed by proposal_id and base_version. Supply the existing activity_id and unchanged evidence_quote, new matching fields and match_evidence.
repair.effect: Revalidates source and target, updates proposal kind and target atomically, increments version and writes an event preserving old and new classification. Resolved rows cannot be repaired. Conflicting tuple or stale version refuses the entire transaction. An identical idempotency key replays the receipt.
repair.execution: No automatic historical reclassification or production repair is performed by this source change.

consumer_adoption: Pin the merged producer revision and verify its deployed release before relying on these fields.
